zone.description: Tailscale tailnet traffic. Closed by default: all inbound traffic on tailscale0, and all inbound traffic from the Tailscale address ranges (100.64.0.0/10 and fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48, which every tailnet uses), is dropped unless a service, port or rich rule is explicitly added to this zone. Nothing is allowed by this file as shipped, not even ssh. Outbound traffic and replies to established connections are unaffected.
